📑 Software Requirement Specification (SRS)
Project Name: Gateway OTP (Next-Generation Smart OTP Verification Gateway)
1. Project Overview & Objective
Gateway OTP is a highly scalable, production-ready, and cost-effective multi-channel One-Time Password
(OTP) Verification Gateway backend engine. The core system architecture is custom-tailored for AI-driven
"Vibe Coding" methodologies and rapid micro-caching standards.

(OTP) Verification Gateway backend engine. The core system architecture is custom-tailored for AI-driven
"Vibe Coding" methodologies and rapid micro-caching standards.
Core Objective: To completely eliminate infrastructure delivery and communication overhead costs for early-
stage startups and small-to-medium software teams. Gateway OTP features a dynamic cost-optimization
routing layer that evaluates channel availability and operational thresholds in real-time to dispatch security
tokens via the most cost-efficient medium possible (WhatsApp $ ightarrow$ Email $ ightarrow$ Fallback

2. Core Architectural Features
•
Cryptographically Secure Token Generation: The system rejects pseudo-random generators (such as

•
Cryptographically Secure Token Generation: The system rejects pseudo-random generators (such as
Math.random() ) due to vulnerability against predictability and guessing attacks. Instead, it utilizes the
native Node.js crypto module to generate unguessable, high-entropy 6-digit numeric verification tokens.
•
Smart Auto-Switching Routing Engine: Implements a cascading waterfall routing mechanism based on

•
Smart Auto-Switching Routing Engine: Implements a cascading waterfall routing mechanism based on
cost-efficiency thresholds:
◦
Priority 1 (Primary): Meta WhatsApp Cloud API — Utilizes the monthly free tier allowance (1,000
user-initiated conversations). System defaults all routing here initially.

Priority 1 (Primary): Meta WhatsApp Cloud API — Utilizes the monthly free tier allowance (1,000
user-initiated conversations). System defaults all routing here initially.
◦
Priority 2 (Secondary Fallback): Resend / Brevo Transactional Email APIs — Automatically shifts
traffic to the email channel if WhatsApp thresholds are exhausted or connection drops occur (3,000+
free monthly emails allowance).

traffic to the email channel if WhatsApp thresholds are exhausted or connection drops occur (3,000+
free monthly emails allowance).
◦
Priority 3 (Tertiary Fallback): Third-Party SMS Gateway — Integrates client-configured telecom
nodes strictly as a final fallback layer if telecom billing balances are active; otherwise, exceptions are
caught gracefully.

caught gracefully.
•
Dynamic Micro-Caching Layer: To eliminate heavy database lookup overheads and disk write
bottlenecks, the engine stores volatile operational tokens inside an in-memory cache. All dynamic OTP
tokens are bound to a strict Time-To-Live (TTL) expiry window of exactly 300 seconds (5 minutes).

•
Anti-Brute Force Protection (Rate Limiting): Restricts malicious iteration attacks against a single
identifier (phone number or email) by enforcing a maximum cap of 3 consecutive failed validation
attempts. Exceeding this cap places the target identifier/IP into a temporary lock down cooldown state for

identifier (phone number or email) by enforcing a maximum cap of 3 consecutive failed validation
attempts. Exceeding this cap places the target identifier/IP into a temporary lock down cooldown state for
15 minutes.

•
Anti-Spam Resend Guardrail: To mitigate API payload exhaustion and prevent resource billing spam
loops, a strict resource lock prevents a generic client from requesting a new token for the same identifier
within 60 seconds of the last successful dispatch.
3. Tech Stack & Infrastructure Design
•

3. Tech Stack & Infrastructure Design
•
Backend Runtime: Node.js environment utilizing a clean, asynchronous JavaScript execution context
driven by the Express.js application framework.
•
State Management & Caching: Redis cache layer. Standalone standalone Redis for local development,

•
State Management & Caching: Redis cache layer. Standalone standalone Redis for local development,
and serverless distributed Upstash Redis for production/staging environments.
•
Cloud Deployment: Managed via Render.com Web Service architecture utilizing an automated CI/CD
deployment pipeline synced directly to the target GitHub repository branch.

4. Database Cache Schema (Redis Key-Value Models)
To guarantee microsecond verification lookups, the cache layers must use the following clean, predictable
Key-Value design structures:
A. Active Token Verification Matrix

Key-Value design structures:
A. Active Token Verification Matrix
•
Key Design Pattern: auth:otp:[CountryCode][PhoneNumber]
•
Data Structure Type: Stringified JSON Map / Hash Matrix

•
Data Structure Type: Stringified JSON Map / Hash Matrix
•
Allocation Lifecycle: Automatically drops via native Redis TTL engine set to exactly 300 seconds.
"auth:otp:919876543210": {
"otp": "584291",

}
B. Client Request Cool-Down State Lock
•
Key Design Pattern: auth:cooldown:[CountryCode][PhoneNumber]
•
Data Structure Type: String Binary Bit Flag

•
Data Structure Type: String Binary Bit Flag
•
Allocation Lifecycle: Automatically drops via native Redis TTL engine set to exactly 60 seconds.
